messages:
jamie: quick Q — our telemetry/metrics sidecar in the 'telemetry' namespace is failing to assume the AWS role. It looks like the sidecar container has automountServiceAccountToken: false in the pod spec. I'm trying to avoid mounting static secrets. Anyone seen this gotcha with IRSA + sidecars?

sarah: yeah, sidecars often get missed. IRSA relies on the projected service account token being available inside the container. If automountServiceAccountToken is false at the pod level or container level, the token won't be projected.

mike: short checklist: 1) serviceAccount must have eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn annotation, 2) pod must reference that SA (serviceAccountName), 3) automountServiceAccountToken must be true or unset so projection works, 4) container needs to read the token from the volume AWS SDK expects (WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE) or AWS SDK v2 auto-detects.

jamie: thanks. We're using helm to deploy the sidecar via the telemetry chart. Current values set the SA to an existing one created by Terraform (we don't create SAs in helm). Here's the values snippet we're trying to apply: 
```yaml
serviceAccount:
  create: false
  name: telemetry-metrics-sa
pod:
  automountServiceAccountToken: false
containers:
  - name: metrics
    image: ghcr.io/redwood/telemetry-metrics:v1.4.2
    env:
      - name: AWS_REGION
        value: us-west-2
```

jamie: (we originally set automount false to avoid mounting tokens in the app container; missed that the sidecar needs it)

olivia: two ways to fix without changing app container behavior: 1) set pod automountServiceAccountToken: true and rely on per-container projected token usage, or 2) use projectedServiceAccountToken volume and mount it only into the metrics container (k8s 1.21+ supports projected token volume with audience/expiration). I prefer #2 because it minimizes token exposure to app container.

mike: example patch for option 2 (pod spec fragment):
```yaml
volumes:
- name: sa-token
  projected:
    sources:
      - serviceAccountToken:
          path: token
          audience: sts.amazonaws.com
          expirationSeconds: 3600
containers:
- name: metrics
  volumeMounts:
    - name: sa-token
      mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
      readOnly: true
  env:
    - name: AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
      value: /var/run/secrets/tokens/token
```

jamie: perfect, that keeps token out of the app. For Terraform part: we already have a module that manages the SA in the telemetry ns. It needs the annotation `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn = arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/telemetry-metrics-role`. I'm opening a tiny tf PR to add that and to ensure SA has automount true (so other charts work). PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4567

olivia: pinging @mike for quick review on the TF PR and helm values change. Also note: if you add expirationSeconds < 60 it might break some SDKs, so stick with 3600 or 604800 depending on workload.

mike: looking now. Two small asks: a) add a note to the chart README about the optional projected-token mount so teams don't accidentally disable it, and b) ensure the TF module sets `automount_service_account_token = true` by default but allows override.

deploy-bot: helm/telemetry attempted deploy failed in staging — metrics container exit 1 (unable to find token at /var/run/secrets/tokens/token). Will re-run after values updated.

jamie: thanks — I'll update the chart values to mount the projected token only into the metrics container and update the TF module in the PR. After PR merges I'll kick the deploy and post results here. cc @sarah @olivia :thumbsup:
